entries.5e8f8f57379207c9: The business is a single-segment operation that provides customer satisfaction mystery shopping research (MSR) as its core service, along with employee satisfaction surveys and consulting. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥2,584 million, of which mystery shopping research accounted for ¥2,576 million and other business for ¥8 million. In the fiscal year ended February 2026, the company conducted 191,000 surveys a year for 717 domestic customer companies and also carried out 29,000 overseas-related surveys.

entries.737e6048b70b4e59: Based on MSR and team survey results, the company provides consulting and training that drive service improvements through a bottom-up approach. entries.8defb49aa0985251: A service that measures employee satisfaction across five perspectives: leadership, team execution capability, team climate, staff initiative and staff satisfaction. Responses are tallied and analyzed through a smartphone app or website, and the diagnosis results are provided as a store chart. Since the service launched in September 2011, the cumulative number of survey respondents has exceeded 3.17 million. The service is also offered as part of "tenpoket," a package combining it with software for stores. The amount is not separately disclosed and is included in "Other" in the revenue breakdown.

entries.d1db53529154c381: A customer satisfaction mystery shopping survey in which registered monitors visit customer companies' stores and other locations as ordinary consumers and evaluate products and services through actual purchasing activity. The company delivers consumer-perspective reports, with survey forms that make heavy use of free-text comments and verification by professionally trained report checkers. The company has 620,000 monitors across Japan. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥2,576 million.
